findings.msg: No link to cookie policy found on this page
findings.fix: Add a footer link to your cookie policy.

findings.msg: No link to contact / imprint found on this page
findings.fix: Add a footer link to your contact / imprint.

findings.msg: Trackers present with no consent mechanism detected: Meta Pixel
findings.fix: Gate these behind a consent banner, or confirm the banner is injected client-side (this scan cannot see that).

findings.msg: Session-replay tools record keystrokes and clicks with no consent gate detected: Hotjar, Inspectlet
findings.fix: Load these only after consent. Under California's wiretapping statute (CIPA), session replay is the most frequently litigated web condition.

findings.msg: No 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information' or 'Your Privacy Choices' link found
findings.fix: California requires a clear opt-out link on the homepage for businesses that sell or share personal information — ad pixels commonly count as sharing.

findings.msg: No sign the site honours the Global Privacy Control browser signal
findings.fix: California requires honouring GPC as a valid opt-out. Most consent platforms support it once enabled — confirm it is switched on.

findings.msg: No 'notice at collection' language found on this page
findings.fix: California expects notice of the categories collected and the purpose, at or before the point of collection.

findings.msg: 1 of 47 tags have no alt attribute
findings.fix: Add alt text. Decorative images take alt="".

not_evaluated: Contrast ratios, keyboard navigation, focus order, and whether alt text is meaningful all require a human or a rendered scan.
